assessment.overall_rationale: The two replicates converge strongly on a shared angiogenic tip-cell sprouting module (L1↔R1) and a partial refinement relationship for the ion-channel/BBB module (L3↔R2 capturing just the mechanosensing half of L3), while the arteriovenous-identity module (L2) and survival/metabolic module (R3) each have only moderate-to-weak cross-matches, reflecting genuine differences in how the replicates partitioned overlapping gene sets into distinct mechanistic narratives.

pair_scores.rationale: Both modules describe the same angiopoietin-CXCR4-NRP1/CDC42 tip-cell sprouting program with TEK suppression driving destabilization, differing only in a minor extra gene (Cdc42ep3/Tnfrsf11b vs Rgs6).
L1's angiogenic sprouting mechanism shares no genes or mechanistic logic with R2's flow-sensitive Kir2.1 mechanotransduction beyond generic brain-endothelium context.

Tnfrsf11b's endothelial survival/angiogenic-support role is shared, but L1's core is tip-cell sprouting whereas R3's core is anti-apoptotic survival and metabolic fueling via Slc1a1, a different central mechanism.

L2 and R1 share nearly identical genes/regulators (Angpt2, Cxcr4, Rgs6, Tek, Nrp1) and both invoke arterial-specification signaling, but L2's central output is arteriovenous identity/boundary patterning while R1's is active sprouting/tip-cell behavior.
Arteriovenous identity specification and Kir2.1 flow-sensing mechanotransduction share no genes or mechanistic logic.
L2's arterial-venous identity program and R3's survival/metabolic support module share no genes and describe unrelated mechanisms.
BBB glutamate transport and flow mechanosensing have no mechanistic or gene overlap with the sprouting/tip-cell angiogenesis program.
R2 is a narrower, single-gene refinement of L3 that isolates the Kcnj2 flow-sensitive mechanotransduction component while dropping the Slc1a1 BBB-transport component.

Slc1a1 and the Tgfbr1/Tgfbr2 regulators are shared, but L3 frames Slc1a1 as glutamate efflux for BBB homeostasis while R3 frames it as a metabolite importer fueling mitochondrial respiration and migration, a different asserted role.
